newsitem.title: USA: Central Parking raises shr total, dividend.
newsitem.headline: Central Parking raises shr total, dividend.

text.p: Central Parking Corp said on Friday that it had increased its dividend and shareholders elected to increase the number of shares outstanding.

The board of directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.0225 a share, an increase from $0.02 a share, Central Parking said. The higher dividend is payable April 11, 1997 to shareholders of record on march 31, 1997, the company said.
Shareholders voted to increase the number of authorized shares to 50 million from 30 million, Central Parking said.
